segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin calls this her 'go-to little helper,' reporting immediate results with regular use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with acne-prone, combination skin and texture concerns reports smoother, hydrated, glowy skin after just two applications.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer describes her skin as fair and reactive and reports zero reaction, zero sensation, and zero change from the product.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 60s report improved moisturizer absorption, reduced lines and puffiness, more even tone, and better-looking skin with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 50s and 60s report lessened lines and puffiness, more even skin tone, and better makeup absorption; no dissent noted among those who mention aging.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report improved moisture absorption, plumper and more hydrated-feeling skin, and better uptake of moisturizer layered afterward.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with reactive skin expected flushing or redness as a possible reaction but experienced none at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report the serum helps other skincare products (vitamin C, glycolic acid, niacinamide, retinol, hyaluronic essence) absorb better without added irritation, though one reviewer using it with a hyaluronic essence found the tingling more uncomfortable.
concerns.spots: One acne-prone reviewer reports no new breakouts or reactions since starting use; another reviewer still had recurring blackheads after four months with no improvement.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the product 'definitely cleared' her skin; another combination/acne-prone reviewer reports smoother texture but is cautious about claiming her acne disappeared.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer specifically reports on oil control or oiliness changes.

extraits.texte: I was very excited to try this product and was even a bit nervous because I thought it might sting or feel like small needle pricks. However, I get neither of those sensations, in fact, I can barely feel anything at all! It really just feels like a serum with a hint of warmth then it goes away. Any "pricks" I feel are like a distant itch. I used this product morning and night and my skin had zero change. It did not make my other skincare more or less effective. This product feels very gimmicky and I will not repurchase. For reference, I have fair and reactive skin. I had zero reaction from this product, not even the slight flushing or redness it says may occur.

I've been using this product as directed for 4 mos & don't notice anything different about my skin. I still have a few blackheads that come & go & my cheeks aren't any softer than they were when I first started using the product. I'm just glad I got this on sale because it was literally a waste of money.

Im always blind buying products just to try out which is probably the best and worst idea for my skin lol . I do tend to have acne prone skin , combination , and have a pore / texture problem. Now im not going to lie to yall and say omg holy grail my acne disappeared ! … this is literally only my second time applying the product. I feel glowy in the morning , my face is smoother to the touch and almost feels like i have absorbed my serum a bit better. My skin feels hydrated & im excited for the future results. There is a slight tingle sensation but no burning is followed . Its more of a rekaxing feel and it didnt bother me throughout the night. Will most likely repurchase this producy if the glowy glass skin persists.

I am absolutely in love with this product! I bought it on a whim during a sale around Black Friday and have been using it regularly. The prickle and tingle are definitely an experience, so be aware that it may feel a little bit like fiberglass being rubbed on your skin. It is never painful, just a bit uncomfortable for a few minutes, especially if I layer it with my hyaluronic essence. My skin looks absolutely flawless after using it, especially the next day. It is like there is a filter on my skin, even when I don't wear makeup. I am pretty acne-prone, but there have been no reactions or breakouts that I have noticed since I started using it. I am considering using some of the other products in the line because of how great it is. I can think of literally nothing I dislike about it.

You need to get this right now! I was afraid to try at first. It feels like little prickly needles when you first put it on but it's not as intense as I thought it would be. My skin has never looked better at 64 years! I am so pleased with the performance of this product I would highly recommend it.

I turn 50 this year and my moisturizer seemed to just sit on top of my skin lately. I started using reedle shot a few times a week and I can see my skin drinking up the moisturizer, lines and puffiness are lessened, my skin tone is more even. I use less makeup and everyone says I'm glowing. Love, love, love!!
